name: PBQ Toledo Fall 2025
information: This competition features blindfolded events only! This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the many other competitions happening in [Ohio](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=Ohio) or [Michigan](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=Michigan). Only one guest per competitor is permitted.
